domains.name: strategy_evolution
domains.routes_on: A genome or population is being scored, ranked, or advanced.

leaves.title: genome_promote_verdict
leaves.question: What should happen to the mutated genome described in `state` next?

options.promote_to_oos: send it onward to out-of-sample review; in-sample gain looks real
options.reject: discard it; the gain is noise or below the survival threshold
options.needs_more_generations: keep evolving this lineage; it is not converged yet
options.quarantine: hold it aside; the evidence contradicts itself and needs a closer look

leaves.title: survival_threshold
leaves.question: Did the genome in `state` clear the survival threshold for its generation?

options.cleared: fitness is at or above the threshold required this generation
options.below: fitness sits under the threshold and it will not survive
options.borderline_review: it sits on the line; a human should set the bar

leaves.title: mutation_operator_choice
leaves.question: Which mutation operator best fits the genome lineage in `state`?

options.weight_perturb: nudge numeric genes only; structure is sound
options.structural: add or remove a gene; the search is stuck in a local optimum
options.crossover: recombine with another lineage; progress has stalled
options.restart_lineage: abandon this lineage; it is converged or degenerate

leaves.title: diversity_triage
leaves.question: Is the population in `state` diverse enough to keep searching?

options.healthy: spread is adequate; continue as planned
options.converged: the population has collapsed onto one lineage and needs injection
options.fragmented: too few viable members survive; relax selection briefly

leaves.title: champion_admit_verdict
leaves.question: Should the candidate in `state` be admitted to the champion registry?

options.admit: add it to the registry as the current champion
options.admit_provisional: register it as a challenger with a bounded trial
options.reject: do not register it; it does not beat the incumbent
options.escalate_human: the call is contestable and a human should decide

leaves.title: champion_replace
leaves.question: Should the registered champion in `state` be replaced by this challenger?

options.replace: the challenger is better on every gated metric
options.keep_incumbent: the champion still wins; the challenger is not better
options.escalate_human: the margin is too thin to automate a swap

leaves.title: generation_budget
leaves.question: How should the generation budget in `state` be spent next?

options.continue: keep the current allocation; progress is steady
options.increase_mutation: spend more on exploration; the search has plateaued
options.increase_evaluation: spend more on validation; results are unstable
options.stop: halt the run; further spend looks wasteful

domains.name: validation_truth
domains.routes_on: A result exists and the question is whether to believe it.

leaves.title: overfit_verdict
leaves.question: Is the backtest result in `state` robust or curve-fit?

options.robust: in-sample and out-of-sample agree; the result looks real
options.curve_fit: the edge disappears out of sample; it is fitted to noise
options.inconclusive: the evidence is too thin to call either way
options.overfit_mild: some degradation out of sample but the core survives

leaves.title: is_oos_divergence
leaves.question: How far do the in-sample and out-of-sample results in `state` diverge?

options.consistent: the two agree closely; no divergence to explain
options.mild_decay: out-of-sample is weaker but still positive
options.severe_decay: out-of-sample collapses; treat the result as unreliable
options.inverted: out-of-sample outperforms in-sample, which itself is suspicious

leaves.title: multiple_testing_burden
leaves.question: Does the number of trials in `state` invalidate this result?

options.acceptable: the trial count is low enough to trust the edge
options.needs_deflation: a deflated Sharpe adjustment is required before believing it
options.too_many_trials: too many trials to trust any single winner

leaves.title: metric_trust
leaves.question: Which metric in `state` should carry the most weight for this decision?

options.deflated_sharpe: trust the deflated Sharpe; it already discounts trial count
options.profit_factor: trust profit factor; the shape of the curve is reliable
options.ulcer_index: trust the ulcer index; drawdown behaviour matters most here
options.information_ratio: trust the information ratio; consistency matters most here
options.none_reliable: no metric here is reliable enough to decide on

leaves.title: backtest_artifact_check
leaves.question: Does the result in `state` show a signature of a pipeline artifact rather than an edge?

options.clean: no artifact signature; the result can be read at face value
options.lookahead_suspect: the timings look too good; suspect lookahead bias
options.survivorship_suspect: the asset set looks cherry-picked after the fact
options.cost_model_suspect: assumed costs look too optimistic to be real

leaves.title: oos_review_routing
leaves.question: Where should the result in `state` go next?

options.accept: accept it and let it proceed to champion review
options.rerun_validation: re-run validation; the current evidence is incomplete
options.reject: reject it; it fails a required bar
options.human_review: send it to a human; the metrics conflict

domains.name: market_state
domains.routes_on: The market or a bar stream needs a state label.

leaves.title: regime_label
leaves.question: Which regime best describes the market state in `state`?

options.range: price oscillates without a directional drift
options.high_vol_chop: large moves in both directions with no persistence
options.transition: the character of the market is changing right now

leaves.title: regime_quality
leaves.question: How much should the regime reading in `state` be trusted?

options.high_confidence: the clusters are well separated and stable
options.low_confidence: the reading sits between states and is unstable
options.model_stale: the fitted model is older than the data warrants
options.unusable: do not act on this regime reading at all

leaves.title: regime_shift_alert
leaves.question: Has the market in `state` shifted out of its previous regime?

options.no_shift: the state is unchanged; keep the current playbook
options.early_shift: early signs of a change; reduce conviction
options.confirmed_shift: the shift is established; the playbook must change

leaves.title: asset_tradeability
leaves.question: Is the asset in `state` tradeable under the current conditions?

options.tradeable: eligible now; data and liquidity support trading it
options.supporting_only: it is a supporting series, never traded directly
options.not_tradeable: it fails a requirement and must not be traded
options.needs_review: eligibility is ambiguous and a human should confirm

leaves.title: bar_type_for_asset
leaves.question: Which bar type should be used for the asset in `state`?

options.temporal: use a fixed-time bar; the series behaves evenly in time
options.dollar_bars: sample by traded value; volume is uneven in time
options.volume_bars: sample by volume; trade intensity is the driver
options.range_bars: sample by price movement; quiet periods are uninformative
options.tick_bars: sample by transaction count on the raw tick stream

leaves.title: timeframe_fit
leaves.question: Which timeframe best matches the intent in `state`?

options.fast: a short horizon suits this decision
options.medium: an intraday-to-daily horizon suits this decision
options.slow: a multi-day horizon suits this decision
options.no_preference: the horizon does not change the answer

domains.name: risk_posture
domains.routes_on: Exposure, sizing or a halt is being considered. Every leaf here is money.

leaves.title: risk_posture
leaves.question: What risk posture fits the conditions in `state`?

options.normal: no change warranted; conditions are within the ordinary band
options.cautious: reduce conviction and size while conditions are unclear
options.de_risk: cut exposure now; the evidence points to elevated risk
options.halt: stop opening new risk and escalate to a human

leaves.title: size_direction_check
leaves.question: Does the request in `state` increase or reduce exposure?

options.reduce_exposure: the request lowers or closes exposure, which may proceed
options.hold_exposure: the request changes nothing and may proceed
options.increase_exposure: the request raises exposure and must not be driven by a model score
options.unclear: the effect on exposure cannot be determined; treat as an increase

leaves.title: daily_loss_breach
leaves.question: Has the loss in `state` breached a daily limit?

options.within_limit: losses remain inside the daily limit
options.approaching_limit: losses are close to the limit; prepare to stop
options.breached: the daily limit is breached and trading must stop
options.unknown_state: the loss cannot be established; treat as breached

leaves.title: kill_switch_trigger
leaves.question: Should the kill switch fire for the conditions in `state`?

options.fire: halt everything now; the condition is a halt condition
options.arm_only: arm the switch but do not fire; the condition is close
options.do_not_fire: the condition is not a halt condition; continue
options.escalate_human: a human must decide; the condition is outside the rules

leaves.title: halt_scope
leaves.question: How wide should the halt in `state` be?

options.all_strategies: halt every strategy; the problem is systemic
options.new_entries_only: block new entries but let existing positions manage out

leaves.title: resume_decision
leaves.question: Should trading resume per the conditions in `state`?

options.resume: the halt condition is cleared; resume normal operation
options.resume_reduced: resume at materially reduced size while it proves out
options.stay_halted: the condition has not cleared; stay halted
options.human_only: only a human may authorise resuming

domains.name: data_integrity
domains.routes_on: Bars, ticks or a feed must be judged before anything is computed on them.

leaves.title: bar_trust
leaves.question: Is the bar or series in `state` trustworthy?

options.trustworthy: it passes the checks; compute on it
options.stale: it has not updated when it should have; do not compute on it
options.corrupt: it fails integrity checks; quarantine it
options.repaired: it had gaps that were repaired; use with reduced confidence

leaves.title: gap_classification
leaves.question: What kind of gap does `state` show?

options.expected: the gap matches a known market closure
options.feed_dropout: the gap looks like a data outage, not a real market pause
options.genuine_move: the gap is a real price move, not missing data
options.unknown: the gap cannot be classified; treat as missing data

leaves.title: outlier_verdict
leaves.question: Is the extreme value in `state` a real print or an error?

options.real_move: a genuine market move; keep it
options.data_error: a bad print; exclude it from computation
options.needs_review: ambiguous; a human should inspect the raw record

leaves.title: feed_health
leaves.question: What is the state of the feed in `state`?

options.healthy: messages are arriving on time and well formed
options.degraded: messages arrive late or out of order but are usable
options.disconnected: the feed is down; work from the last known good state
options.unknown: feed health cannot be determined; assume it is down

leaves.title: anomaly_class
leaves.question: What class of anomaly is the event in `state`?

options.market_event: a genuine market event that must be handled as such
options.system_fault: an internal fault in our own pipeline
options.upstream_issue: a problem at the venue or data provider
options.benign_noise: ordinary variation; nothing to act on

leaves.title: data_source_preference
leaves.question: Which source should be trusted for `state`?

options.primary: use the primary source; it is healthy
options.secondary: the primary is suspect; use the secondary
options.reconcile: the sources disagree; reconcile before computing
options.none: no source is trustworthy enough; do not compute

domains.name: execution_ops
domains.routes_on: An order, a failure or a change needs classifying. Nothing here places an order.

leaves.title: execution_style
leaves.question: Which execution style suits the intent in `state`? (Classify only — this leaf never executes.)

options.passive: post and wait; the spread matters more than the fill certainty
options.aggressive: cross the spread; certainty of fill matters more
options.wait: do not send yet; conditions are unfavourable
options.split: work the order in slices to limit impact

leaves.title: failure_triage
leaves.question: What is the failure in `state` and how urgent is it?

options.rejected_retryable: the venue rejected it and it can safely be retried
options.rejected_fatal: the venue rejected it and retrying would repeat the failure
options.partial_fill: the order filled only partly and the remainder needs a decision
options.disconnect: connectivity was lost; positions must be reconciled before anything else

leaves.title: reconciliation_verdict
leaves.question: Do our records and the venue records in `state` agree?

options.mismatch: they disagree and the difference must be resolved before trading
options.stale_local: our view is stale; refresh before deciding
options.venue_unknown: the venue cannot be queried; assume mismatch

leaves.title: rollback_verdict
leaves.question: Is the regression in `state` bad enough to roll back?

options.rollback: revert now; the regression breaches a required bar
options.forward_fix: keep it and fix forward; the regression is tolerable
options.hold_and_watch: neither yet; gather more evidence first
options.human_decision: a human must decide; the trade-off is not automatic

leaves.title: change_risk
leaves.question: How risky is the change in `state` to apply?

options.moderate_risk: touches shared behaviour; apply with a staged rollout
options.high_risk: touches money or state; require review before applying
options.forbidden: crosses an architecture boundary; do not apply

leaves.title: sot_conformance_verdict
leaves.question: Does the change in `state` conform to the source of truth?

options.violates: it contradicts the source of truth and must not land
options.unspecified: the source of truth does not cover this case
options.needs_sot_update: the contract should be amended, which is a human decision
